OncallBot: ALERT: service/inference-api - 5xx rate spike in us-west-2 (p95 errors 4.8% over 5m) - paging primary

Alex: saw this, thanks bot. Maria are you on for primary?

Maria: yep i'm on. picking up now. starting triage.

TJ: i'm secondary, standing by.

Maria: quick customer impact: embeddings requests returning 502 intermittently, customers in paid-tier reporting latency/timeouts. no full outage but error rate > SLO (SLO: 99.9% success).

Alex: rough count? how many customers affected?

Maria: Sentry shows ~12 distinct tenant IDs with recent 502s, top 3 account ids make up ~70% of errors.

Priya: FYI I see increased qps from a batch job in us-west-2 that started ~10m ago, could be noisy neighbor.

Maria: good catch. checking autoscale and GPU pool.

SRE-Bot: Deploy-Alert: rolling deploy to inference-runtime completed 18m ago in us-west-2 on pool-gpu-4.

Alex: can we correlate deploys to error spike? Maria, can you grep logs around deploy window?

Maria: running quick grep...

Maria: logs snippet: ```
2026-02-11T16:12:03Z inference-runtime: model-serving error write: broken pipe
2026-02-11T16:12:08Z nginx upstream 502 for /v1/embeddings
2026-02-11T16:12:09Z kv-cache: eviction pressure 92%```

TJ: eviction pressure + batch job = memory/kv thrash possibility. if KV cache misbehaves it can return upstream 502s.

Alex: action items: (1) throttle or block the noisy batch job (Priya) (2) adjust autoscale / restart unhealthy pods (Maria) (3) suppress noisy alert signal temporarily if we can reduce pages (TJ)

Priya: I can pause the job in 2 min. pausing now.

Priya: paused. monitoring.

Maria: restarting a subset of model-serving pods to recycle KV caches. doing canary restart on pool-gpu-4.

SRE-Bot: Restart job started: pool-gpu-4 - 6 pods to recycle

Maria: canary restart completed for 2 pods. error rate dropping to 1.7% p95 now.

Alex: good. if slope keeps going down we can avoid broader restarts. TJ can you hold off suppression for another 5m? prefer to keep alerts until we stabilize.

TJ: will not suppress yet. if noise persists and after restarts we still see >3% we can move to temp threshold raise.

Maria: baseline check: current alert threshold triggers at error_rate > 1% for 5m. proposal: temp raise to 3% for the next 30m while we monitor restarts.

Alex: that's reasonable if we log the change and create follow-up to revert. Priya make sure to capture pause time.

Priya: logged pause at 16:22 UTC in incident ticket #INC-20260211-07.

Maria: error rate now 0.9% p95 and trending down. KV eviction at 45%. looks healthy.

Alex: nice. Maria do you want to continue as primary for the next 40m or handoff?

Maria: I can take the full 1hr to finish checks and then hand to Jamie at 17:30 UTC. leaving notes in the runbook.

Alex: ok Jamie will be secondary then handoff to you at 17:30. Jamie ack?

Jamie: ack. i'll be on deck at 17:30.

TJ: small reminder: if we do the temp alert change, use alerting-configs -> set rule inference_api_5xx_threshold to 3% and annotate with incident id. make sure oncall-bot logs the change.

Maria: added runbook note: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/inference/5xx-triage - updated steps 2 and 4 with eviction checks and pod recycle command.

Alex: please paste the restart command here for future oncall reference.

Maria: command used: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-serving -n inference --selector=pool=pool-gpu-4 --grace-period=60```

Priya: customer comms: support already opened inbound tickets for the top 3 accounts, STATUS: investigating. recommend sending a brief note summarizing temporary degradation and mitigation steps once stable.

Alex: agreed. wait until error < 0.5% for 10m then send comms. Maria can you take that?

Maria: will do. I'll also create a post-incident checklist item to evaluate autoscale thresholds and KV cache sizing.

SRE-Bot: Incident created: INC-20260211-07 - inference-api 5xx spike - assigned to Maria.

Alex: update: looks stable for 12m, p95 errors 0.3%. I'll close the urgent paging; keep monitoring.

TJ: going to temporarily mute the high-noise pager rule for 30m in the alerting UI but not the incident channel; annotating with INC-20260211-07. doing now.

TJ: muted. annotation: "temp threshold raise to 3% planned but not applied - muted noisy alerting rule to avoid duplicate pages"

Maria: thanks. prepping handoff notes for Jamie: key points - cause likely KV eviction triggered by noisy batch job + recent deploy; mitigations applied - paused job, canary pod restarts; followups - evaluate autoscale and cache sizing, consider backpressure on batch jobs.

Jamie: got it. i'll pick up at 17:30, check dashboards (SLO dashboard + model-serving logs), and confirm revert actions (unpause job after we confirm stability).

Alex: thank you team. final: keep INC ticket updated, add timeboxed temp alert change if we ever apply, and make sure to revert muting by 17:50 UTC.

Maria: noted. handing off now to Jamie.

Jamie: thanks, taking over. :thumbsup:
